Core external context is absent or schema-invalid: DXY, US 10Y, reference futures, and/or news calendar must be added before external-context baselines.

external_context_acquisition_inventory.label: US Dollar Index / DXY proxy
external_context_acquisition_inventory.alignment_notes: Normalize to UTC date/session; forward-fill daily context into intraday XAUUSD bars only after the close/time is known.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.use_in_next_stage: Dollar regime, DXY slope, DXY momentum, dollar-risk filter.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.acquisition_notes: Use any reliable historical DXY or broad USD-index proxy export. Keep raw source unchanged and document source/vendor in a source column or README.

external_context_acquisition_inventory.label: US 10-year Treasury yield
external_context_acquisition_inventory.alignment_notes: Normalize percent yield consistently. If file uses close, map it to yield_value during later normalization.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.use_in_next_stage: Nominal-yield regime, yield slope, yield shock filter.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.acquisition_notes: Use a consistent daily 10Y yield series. Do not mix percent and decimal formats without documenting conversion.

external_context_acquisition_inventory.label: CME GC/MGC futures reference feed
external_context_acquisition_inventory.alignment_notes: If continuous futures are used, document roll method. Use only as reference/context until feed alignment is audited.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.use_in_next_stage: Broker CFD vs market-wide direction check, gap/reference validation, futures trend context.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.acquisition_notes: Use a clean continuous GC/MGC reference feed if available. Avoid mixing contracts without a documented continuous-series method.

external_context_acquisition_inventory.label: High-impact macro news calendar
external_context_acquisition_inventory.minimum_granularity: event timestamp; UTC or timezone column required
external_context_acquisition_inventory.alignment_notes: Convert to UTC. Later blackout windows must be pre-defined, e.g. -2h/+2h or event-type-specific windows.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.use_in_next_stage: News blackout, event-risk regime, no-trade windows around CPI/FOMC/NFP/jobs/inflation/rate events.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.acquisition_notes: Calendar must include high-impact US macro events and timestamps. If only date is available, mark time confidence as low.

external_context_acquisition_inventory.label: US 2-year Treasury yield
external_context_acquisition_inventory.alignment_notes: Use together with 10Y to build curve and rate-expectation context.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.acquisition_notes: Optional for first pass; valuable if easily available alongside 10Y.

external_context_acquisition_inventory.label: US real yield / TIPS proxy
external_context_acquisition_inventory.alignment_notes: If added, keep nominal-vs-real-yield semantics explicit.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.acquisition_notes: Optional but strategically useful; can be added after DXY and 10Y.

external_context_acquisition_inventory.label: FOMC/rate decision calendar
external_context_acquisition_inventory.minimum_granularity: event timestamp preferred; date acceptable with low time confidence
external_context_acquisition_inventory.alignment_notes: Optional if unified news calendar already covers FOMC/rate events.
external_context_acquisition_inventory.use_in_next_stage: FOMC blackout and rate-decision event regime.

external_context_acquisition_inventory.label: US CPI calendar
external_context_acquisition_inventory.minimum_granularity: event timestamp preferred; date acceptable with low time confidence
external_context_acquisition_inventory.alignment_notes: Optional if unified news calendar already covers CPI/inflation events.

external_context_acquisition_inventory.label: US employment/NFP calendar
external_context_acquisition_inventory.minimum_granularity: event timestamp preferred; date acceptable with low time confidence
external_context_acquisition_inventory.alignment_notes: Optional if unified news calendar already covers employment/NFP events.
